paper.$description: Paper — Page background and low-contrast section surface

white.$description: White — Terminal chrome, badges, light controls, and elevated content surfaces

ink.$description: Ink — Primary headings, navigation, body text, icons, and hairline outlined controls

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Terminal demonstration background and dark text-on-light supporting surface

deep-graphite.$description: Deep Graphite — Dark installation-panel fill and inset terminal depth

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Body copy, helper text, secondary links, and subdued icons

steel.$description: Steel — Inactive controls and muted icon strokes

rule-gray.$description: Rule Gray — 1px borders, feature-grid dividers, outlined control borders, and muted tiled surfaces

aqua-mist.$description: Aqua Mist — Pale promotional card surface and cool highlighted section wash

aqua-midtone.$description: Aqua Midtone — Secondary aqua surface for layered promotional artwork

outline-aqua.$description: Outline Aqua — Outlined documentation-control border and monospace command highlight

butler-teal.$description: Butler Teal — Filled login control and large conversion panels — saturated teal punctuates the mostly paper-and-ink interface

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Badge text, command syntax, icon fills, and teal display-text accents

but-head.$description: Display and section headings plus large segmented-control labels. Its narrow, high-contrast serif construction makes 400-weight text feel editorial rather than bold; use 82px/82px for the hero, 60px/60px for section headings, 48px/48px on dark command panels, and 40px/60px for the wordmark.

inter.$description: Navigation, body copy, feature descriptions, badges, links, and UI labels. Keep prose at 16px/24px weight 400, navigation at 14px/16.8px weight 500, and feature titles at 18px/21.6px weight 600.

geist-mono.$description: Terminal commands and code-style instructional text at 14px/21px; its monospaced texture distinguishes executable text from the editorial headline voice.

source-code-pro.$description: Fallback monospace treatment for small code fragments at 14px/21px.
